expectedStoreId.description: Store UUID from the opt-in handshake, saved with the key BEFORE the first import and replayed unchanged; never replaced by the current store. A different store is refused before any effect.

kind.description: Kind of attached resource: image input or generic file bytes.

source.description: Opaque caller identity of the selected source, such as the absolute path a local client read or a task artifact id. Bound into the key only; the daemon never reads, resolves, stores or returns it.

lifetime.description: Opt in to a managed resource lifetime (support: the POST /v2/resources/:id/release catalog descriptor). Bound into the key like kind, mime, name and source.

sha256.description: Exact digest of the bytes: "sha256:" and 64 lowercase hex digits.

content.description: Required to begin an import. Omit it to read or replay an already bound key without touching the source.

ControlUploadImportRequest.description: Keyed import of one ordinary attachment through the upload owner.
